description: HW5 Problem 4 smoke-test evidence. One record per MCP tool: the exact prompt given, the exact MCP tool name called, and the unaltered tool output.

records.prompt: Investigate open Ticket 101 using the MCP tools available in this project. Determine whether the customer order can currently be fulfilled, and report the linked invoice and vendor context. Use the appropriate MCP tool and return only information grounded in data/campus_customs_new.db.

records.prompt: Investigate open Ticket 102 using the MCP tools available in this project. Use the appropriate MCP tool and return only information grounded in data/campus_customs_new.db.

tool_output.subject: Rent due
